request: JFK to Delhi on December 15th for the evaluation design workshop on the 18th. I told Global Operations about the trip on November 27th. It's a long trip and I'll claim per diem for the travel days; just the cheapest economy seat please.

must_keep.quote: Air travel must be arranged to the fullest extent possible using the lowest economy fare (coach) that meets the business need (including arrival and departure times) via the most direct and expeditious route that can be changed with a fee.
must_keep.why: the lowest changeable economy fare that meets the business need, on the most direct route

must_keep.quote: Travelers to the following countries must inform Global Operations (GlobalOperations@poverty-action.org) prior to booking travel and at least two weeks in advance of travel so appropriate safety and security measures can be put into place including obtaining temporary corporate insurance coverage: Afghanistan; Algeria; Angola; Bahrain; Bosnia & Herzegovina; Burundi; Cambodia; Central African Republic; Cuba; Democratic Republic of Congo; Egypt; Ethio pia; Guinea- Bissau; Haiti; India; Indonesia; Iran; Iraq; Israel, Kosovo; Kuwait; Kyrgyz Republic; Lebanon; Libya; Niger; North Korea; Northern Ireland; Pakistan; Somalia; South Sudan; Sudan; Syria; Turkey; Venezuela; West Bank and Gaza; Yemen; Zimbabwe.
must_keep.why: listed countries (India among them): Global Operations told before booking, two weeks ahead

must_keep.quote: All domestic travel must be approved by the traveler's Assignment Supervisor. International travel must be approved by the Country Director (for Country Office staff) or appropriate Global Team Director (for Global Team staff).
must_keep.why: domestic travel: Assignment Supervisor; international: Country or Global Team Director

distractors.quote: IPA employees are eligible to receive per diem only when traveling for more than 12 consecutive hours in one day.
distractors.why: a per diem hour rule, not a flight rule

distractors.quote: must request a security briefing from International SOS at least one week prior to travel.
distractors.why: a briefing rule, not a booking rule

design_notes: India is on the list of line 147: Global Operations was told on November 27th, before booking (November 30th) and 18 days before travel (at least two weeks, across the month end). The per diem hours (lines 270-272) and the possible rest stop in Frankfurt (not asked for) do not change the fare: the Air India nonstop at the lowest economy fare.
